verdict.rationale: treg is a stateless tool and API gateway that agents call on demand. The evidence documents no scheduler, trigger, or background-automation feature of treg itself. The 'repeat next week' use case is a manual one-off pattern the user's agent would have to drive, not a recurring schedule. A community reviewer explicitly notes treg lacks state such as webhooks, signals and schedules.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
